attchmntText: SEL Manufacturing Company Limited has informed the Exchange about change in Management
voiceSummary: SEL Manufacturing Company Limited announced outcomes of its Board meeting held on 14 November 2026. The Board approved the appointment of Mrs. Rajdeep Jagotra as Additional Director and Chairperson, Mr. Iqbal Singh as Additional Director, and Mr. Ajab Singh as Additional Director. Mrs. Jagotra, Mr. Singh, and Mr. Singh were appointed with effect from 14 November 2026. The Board also approved the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. Due to resignations of Ms. Meghna Mahendra Savla, Ms. Menka Rajdev Yadav, and Mr. Dharminder Pal, the Audit Committee, Nomination and Remuneration Committee, Risk Management Committee, and Stakeholders Relationship Committee were reconstituted. Mrs. Jagotra chairs the Audit Committee. Mr. Iqbal Singh chairs the Nomination and Remuneration Committee. Mr. Rajeev Bhalla chairs the Risk Management Committee. Mr. Ajab Singh chairs the Stakeholders Relationship Committee.

attchmntText: SEL Manufacturing Company Limited has informed the Exchange about the Board Meeting to be held on Saturday, November 14, 2026, to consider the Unaudited Financial Results for the Quarter and Half Year ended 30th September, 2026.
voiceSummary: SEL Manufacturing Company Limited has intimated that its Board of Directors meeting is scheduled for Saturday, November 14, 2026. The meeting will consider and approve the unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The notice was issued pursuant to Regulation 29 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The company is listed on BSE with scrip code 532886 and on NSE with symbol SELMC. The intimation was signed by Naveen Arora, Whole-time Director, with DIN 09114373.
